title: Event Horizon
description: Real-time WebGL2 black hole ray tracer with a full spinning (Kerr) mode: live null-geodesic integration, frame dragging and an off-axis shadow, a volumetric self-shadowing accretion disk with exact relativistic shifts and a live line spectrograph, a free-fall 'rain frame' plunge with relativistic aberration, HDR bloom, and a gravitationally-lensed starfield — plus an Observatory that computes the exact analytic shadow (Kerr critical curve) and light-bending, and verifies the whole engine live with a 20-check GR self-test suite.
